inputs.anchor: selected new-source M4 inner OOF and three-seed outer refits
inputs.motion_residual: selected A3 unrestricted-template inner OOF and three-seed outer refits
inputs.temporal_metadata: canonical source-swap memory_data exact +/-1 second same-track edges

selection.fit_source: selected scenario-held inner OOF predictions inside outer training only
selection.outer_metric_embargo: No outer-held label may be indexed until all five fold receipts and prediction artifacts are complete and independently replayed.

control_contract.zero_residual: r0 must preserve exact cached M4 bytes for every seed
control_contract.component_ablations: r1-r4 reuse the primary fold coefficients with omitted components set exactly to zero
control_contract.shuffled_neighbor: preserve each row's exact-neighbor count, sample pseudo-neighbours within scenario only, and exclude self and true neighbours
control_contract.seed_aggregation: apply each arm independently to aligned M4/A3 seed probabilities, then arithmetic-mean probabilities
control_contract.fallback: a row with no valid exact neighbour receives no temporal update

interpretation.claim_scope: adaptive internal evidence on repeatedly used Okutama scenarios
interpretation.confirmation_required: Freeze code, coefficients/selection and endpoints before testing untouched scenarios or an external dataset.
interpretation.forbidden_claim: This cached study alone is not independent confirmation or publication-grade generalization evidence.
